title: Pure Toy
summary: The 2024 Toy cards and the older monsters with "Toy" in their names, with generic Rank 4s, Links and staples; the page's White Forest partner is left out. The page calls Toy an engine, but its cards search and summon each other. Toy Soldier searches Toy Box, or a Level 4 LIGHT monster once Toy Box is up. Toy Box Sets up to two Toys from the hand, Deck, field or GY in the Spell & Trap Zone and can destroy them later. Toy Soldier and Toy Tank summon themselves when a Set copy is sent to the GY, and Toy Tank tributes itself to summon a Level 6 or lower monster. Toy Box also destroys an attacker by sending a Set card. The Black Goat Laughs stops one monster name from being Special Summoned.
main: Newest starter: searches Toy Box, or a Level 4 LIGHT with Toy Box; summons itself from a Set.
Newest: summons itself from a Set; tributes itself for a Level 6 or lower monster.
Sets itself as a Spell; Toy Box can Set it from the Deck.
Summons itself and a second copy when they control more monsters.
Newest Continuous Spell: Sets two Toys from anywhere; destroys Set cards to trigger them.
Stops one monster name being Special Summoned; stops its effects from the GY.
